What, then, is the advantage of being a Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?
How then is the Jew better off? or what profit is there in circumcision?
這樣說來，猶太人有甚麼長處？割禮有甚麼益處呢？
Much in every way. First of all, they have been entrusted with the very words of God.
Much in every way: first of all because the words of God were given to them.
凡事大有好處：第一是神的聖言交託他們。
What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
And if some have no faith, will that make the faith of God without effect?
即便有不信的，這有何妨呢？難道他們的不信就廢掉神的信嗎？
Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”
In no way: but let God be true, though every man is seen to be untrue; as it is said in the Writings, That your words may be seen to be true, and you may be seen to be right when you are judged.
斷乎不能！不如說，神是真實的，人都是虛謊的。如經上所記：你責備人的時候，顯為公義；被人議論的時候，可以得勝。
But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.
But if the righteousness of God is supported by our wrongdoing what is to be said? is it wrong for God to be angry (as men may say)?
我且照著人的常話說，我們的不義若顯出神的義來，我們可以怎麼說呢？神降怒，是他不義嗎？
Certainly not! In that case, how could God judge the world?
In no way: because if it is so, how is God able to be the judge of all the world?
斷乎不是！若是這樣，神怎能審判世界呢？
However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
But if, because I am untrue, God being seen to be true gets more glory, why am I to be judged as a sinner?
若神的真實，因我的虛謊越發顯出他的榮耀，為甚麼我還受審判，好像罪人呢？
Why not say, as some slanderously claim that we say, “Let us do evil that good may result”? Their condemnation is deserved!
Let us not do evil so that good may come (a statement which we are falsely said by some to have made), because such behaviour will have its right punishment.
為甚麼不說，我們可以作惡以成善呢？這是毀謗我們的人說我們有這話。這等人定罪是該當的。
What then? Are we any better? Not at all. For we have already made the charge that Jews and Greeks alike are all under sin.
What then? are we worse off than they? In no way: because we have before made it clear that Jews as well as Greeks are all under the power of sin;
這卻怎麼樣呢？我們比他們強嗎？決不是的！因我們已經證明：猶太人和希臘人都在罪惡之下。
As it is written: “There is no one righteous, not even one.
As it is said in the holy Writings, There is not one who does righteousness;
就如經上所記：沒有義人，連一個也沒有。
There is no one who understands, no one who seeks God.
Not one who has the knowledge of what is right, not one who is a searcher after God;
沒有明白的；沒有尋求神的；
All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one.”
They have all gone out of the way, there is no profit in any of them; there is not one who does good, not so much as one:
都是偏離正路，一同變為無用。沒有行善的，連一個也沒有。
“Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.” “The venom of vipers is on their lips.”
Their throat is like an open place of death; with their tongues they have said what is not true: the poison of snakes is under their lips:
他們的喉嚨是敞開的墳墓；他們用舌頭弄詭詐，嘴唇裡有虺蛇的毒氣，
“Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.”
Whose mouth is full of curses and bitter words:
滿口是咒罵苦毒。
“Their feet are swift to shed blood;
Their feet are quick in running after blood;
殺人流血，他們的腳飛跑，
ruin and misery lie in their wake,
Destruction and trouble are in their ways;
所經過的路便行殘害暴虐的事。
and the way of peace they have not known.”
And of the way of peace they have no knowledge:
平安的路，他們未曾知道；
“There is no fear of God before their eyes.”
There is no fear of God before their eyes.
他們眼中不怕神。
Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
Now, we have knowledge that what the law says is for those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped, and all men may be judged by God:
我們曉得律法上的話都是對律法以下之人說的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在神審判之下。
Therefore no one will be justified in His sight by works of the law. For the law merely brings awareness of sin.
Because by the works of the law no man is able to have righteousness in his eyes, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.
所以凡有血氣的，沒有一個因行律法能在神面前稱義，因為律法本是叫人知罪。
But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been revealed, as attested by the Law and the Prophets.
But now without the law there is a revelation of the righteousness of God, to which witness is given by the law and the prophets;
但如今，神的義在律法以外已經顯明出來，有律法和先知為證：
And this righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,
That is, the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ, to all those who have faith; and one man is not different from another,
就是神的義，因信耶穌基督加給一切相信的人，並沒有分別。
for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
For all have done wrong and are far from the glory of God;
因為世人都犯了罪，虧缺了神的榮耀；
and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
And they may have righteousness put to their credit, freely, by his grace, through the salvation which is in Christ Jesus:
如今卻蒙神的恩典，因基督耶穌的救贖，就白白地稱義。
God presented Him as the atoning sacrifice through faith in His blood, in order to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance He had passed over the sins committed beforehand.
Whom God has put forward as the sign of his mercy, through faith, by his blood, to make clear his righteousness when, in his pity, God let the sins of earlier times go without punishment;
神設立耶穌作挽回祭，是憑著耶穌的血，藉著人的信，要顯明神的義；因為他用忍耐的心寬容人先時所犯的罪，
He did this to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and to justify the one who has faith in Jesus.
And to make clear his righteousness now, so that he might himself be upright, and give righteousness to him who has faith in Jesus.
好在今時顯明他的義，使人知道他自己為義，也稱信耶穌的人為義。
Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. On what principle? On that of works? No, but on that of faith.
What reason, then, is there for pride? It is shut out. By what sort of law? of works? No, but by a law of faith.
既是這樣，哪裡能誇口呢？沒有可誇的了。用何法沒有的呢？是用立功之法嗎？不是，乃用信主之法。
For we maintain that a man is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
For this reason, then, a man may get righteousness by faith without the works of the law.
所以（有古卷：因為）我們看定了：人稱義是因著信，不在乎遵行律法。
Is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,
Or is God the God of Jews only? is he not in the same way the God of Gentiles? Yes, of Gentiles:
難道神只作猶太人的神嗎？不也是作外邦人的神嗎？是的，也作外邦人的神。
since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
If God is one; and he will give righteousness because of faith to those who have circumcision, and through faith to those who have not circumcision.
神既是一位，他就要因信稱那受割禮的為義，也要因信稱那未受割禮的為義。
Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Certainly not! Instead, we uphold the law.
Do we, then, through faith make the law of no effect? in no way: but we make it clear that the law is important.
這樣，我們因信廢了律法嗎？斷乎不是！更是堅固律法。
